articles.title: Wladimir Klitschko
articles.extract: Wladimir Klitschko is a Ukrainian former professional boxer who competed from 1996 to 2017 and held multiple heavyweight world championships between 2000 and 2015.

articles.title: Jansen Panettiere
articles.extract: Jansen Panettiere was an American actor known for The Secrets of Jonathan Sperry, The Perfect Game, The Martial Arts Kid, and several animated voice roles.

articles.title: Michelle Trachtenberg
articles.extract: Michelle Trachtenberg was an American actress whose work included Harriet the Spy, The Adventures of Pete & Pete, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, and Gossip Girl.

articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
articles.extract: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a 2026 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man. It is the fourth film in the MCU Spider-Man series.

articles.title: Lanterns (TV series)
articles.extract: Lanterns is an HBO superhero series based on the DC Comics Green Lantern characters Hal Jordan and John Stewart, who investigate a murder and a wider mystery.

articles.title: Milo Ventimiglia
articles.extract: Milo Ventimiglia is an American actor known for Gilmore Girls, Heroes, This Is Us, and film and television roles dating to the 1990s.

articles.title: Awarapan 2
articles.extract: Awarapan 2 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language action thriller and a sequel to the 2007 film Awarapan. It stars Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, and Shabana Azmi.

articles.title: Jason Arday
articles.extract: Jason Arday was a British academic and author who taught sociology of education at Cambridge and received international attention amid accusations about his research and autobiography.

articles.title: Cardiomegaly
articles.extract: Cardiomegaly is an enlarged heart, usually resulting from an underlying condition that makes the heart work harder, such as hypertension or heart valve disease.

articles.title: Google
articles.extract: Google is a multinational technology company focused on search, online advertising, cloud computing, software, artificial intelligence, and consumer electronics.
